title: Jane zehra-o-ali janne baradar abbas
body:
roke farmate the yeh sibte payamber abbas
ab na qasim hain na akber hain asghar abbas
koi baqi na raha humdam-o- yawar abbas
dasht-e- ghurbat main luta mera bhara ghar abbas
<<MINI>>
jane zehra-o-ali janne baradar abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
1. bekasi sarf-e-buka chashme aza nouha kuna
hasrat-o-yaas kare gham main teri aaho fugan
khoon-e-dil khoon-e-jigar hain meri ankhon se rawan
al madad aye pisar-e-fatahe khaibar abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
2. khake sine pe sina margaya akber mera
hogaya dasht-o-bayaba ki tarha ghar mera
juz alam koi nahi monis-o-yawar mera
meri tanhayi pe khush hain yeh sitamgar abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
3. chashme tanhayi main pinha hain qayamat ka sama
asr ka lamha-e-akhir tabar-o-tegh-o-sina
kund khanjar yeh gala maa meri masruf-e-buka
koun dekhega qayamat ka ye manzar abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
4.mera abbas mera khuvat-e-bazoo mera chain
jiske marne se adoo khush hain haram karte hai bain
har ghadi saniye zehra se yeh kehte the hussain
tha behan ek mukamal mera lashkar abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
5. hai mere pesh-e-nazar shaam-e- ghariba ka sama
be rida zainab-o-kulsum woh khaimo ka dhuwa aur beemar ko pehnayege yeh tokh-e-gara
qatl ke baad mere hoga yeh mehshar abbas
6. shai yeh kehte the farid ab mera jarar nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
dil giraftar-e-alam hai mera ghamqaar nahi
shaan thi jis se alam ki wo alamdar nahi
kise fariyad kare sibte payambar abbas
<<MINI>>
jane zehra-o-ali janne baradar abbas
